visual.description: Near-black background used across all page sections as the primary canvas.
Pure white used for large headings and primary display text throughout the page.
Off-white used for body copy and standard paragraph text on dark backgrounds.
Medium gray used for secondary body text, descriptions, and de-emphasized content.
Darker muted gray used for the most de-emphasized text passages that fade as user reads.
Bright mint green used for the primary CTA button 'Apply now' and accent highlights like '$3M'.
Dark charcoal used as card and panel backgrounds, e.g. the funding categories card.
Slightly lighter dark surface used for inner card elements and nested UI surfaces.
Very dark background for the sticky navigation bar in its default top-of-page state.
Dark charcoal nav background used when nav is in scrolled/opaque state.
White text used for navigation links in both nav states.
Light gray used for regular nav link items like About, Launch, Advisors, Apply.
Vivid green used for the 'Apply now' pill button and date milestone badges like 'Feb 18, 2026'.
Near-white fill used for the secondary 'Contact us' button background.
Red dot used as a status indicator in the 'Applications are closed' badge.
Orange/amber accent color used for section label icons like 'Build in public' and 'Market feedback' tags.
Deep iridescent dark background of the hero section with subtle blue-purple shimmer from the background visual.
Very dark border/divider color used between timeline entries in the Hackathon timeline section.
Near-white used for the 'Applications are closed' pill badge background.
Deepest black used for the footer area below the CTA section.
